note: vespera-bridge: the WebFlux proxy rejects a declared Content-Length of exactly the built-in 2147483639-byte single-array bound with an upfront 413 (servlet parity) instead of aggregating about 2 GiB and failing with a 500; the servlet 413 for a body that reached that bound now names the bound and the configured vespera.bridge.max-buffered-request-bytes instead of reporting the bound as the property value. The configuration metadata no longer gives management.health.vespera.enabled a fixed default of true (unset, it follows management.health.defaults.enabled). Docs: the README points at the Gradle plugin for placing the cdylib instead of a demo Gradle task that no longer exists.
